books.title: Atomic Habits by James Clear | Full Audiobook
books.summary: Hello and welcome. Tonight or whenever you've chosen to press play, invite you into a journey that may seem quiet at first, even unremarkable. But as the minutes pass and the ideas begin to build, you may come to realize this is no ordinary self-help book.

books.title: Master Your Inner World First: Control Yourself, Control Life  | Mindset Audiobook
books.summary: Most people don't realize when they lose control of their lives. It doesn't happen all at once. It happens quietly in small moments when you react instead of choose.

books.title: Success Begins the Day You Take Yourself Seriously | Mindset Audiobook
books.summary: One day you realize something uncomfortable. No one is coming to take your life seriously for you. Not your boss, not your friends, not even your family.
